about: Colour palettes for Doodle Studio 3D's Materials tab. Each names the colour-theory idea behind it. Roles: character (the lead's fill), ink (outfits and drawn details), wall, floor, ceiling, pieces (furniture and props, picked per piece), accent (rugs and small things), ambient (the light that fills the shadows).

palettes.name: Brand mustard
palettes.theory: One hue: the Doodle Studio mustard and ink

palettes.name: Sunbaked
palettes.theory: Analogous warm: sand, apricot and terracotta, neighbours on the wheel

palettes.name: Teal & coral
palettes.theory: Complementary: teal walls against warm coral and mustard

palettes.name: Playroom
palettes.theory: Triadic: mustard, cobalt and berry, evenly spaced

palettes.name: Dusk
palettes.theory: Split-complementary: mustard against violet and blue-violet

palettes.name: Sage
palettes.theory: Monochrome: one green in light, mid and deep values

palettes.name: Nursery
palettes.theory: Pastel tetradic: pink, mint, butter and periwinkle at high value

palettes.name: Midnight
palettes.theory: Analogous cool with a warm accent: navy blues and one lamp of mustard
